name: House of Commons of Canada
notes: 343 seats; vacant seats are shown as Vacant.

name: Senate of Canada
notes: 105 seats, appointed by the Governor General on the Prime Minister's advice until age 75; vacant seats are shown as Vacant. Who sits and their group are from the Senate's own list of senators. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.

name: Assemblée nationale du Québec
notes: 127 seats after the general election of 5 October 2026 (the Coalition Avenir Québec won none). Seats by party are from the Assembly's own list of members in office. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.

name: Legislative Assembly of Ontario
notes: 124 seats. Seats by party are from the Assembly's own list of current members. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
